locations.label: Power House switch
locations.description: Turn on power in the Power House on the spawn side, then cross the Catwalk and work through the prison to Building 64 for the second switch. Kill the first Warden and collect his key. Build the Spectral Shield, open Pack-a-Punch and feed the three wall dogs before starting the quest. Shield essence: check the blue electrical boxes in Library, Michigan Avenue and Times Square. Only one holds the part. Shield door: check the Citadel Tunnels staircase, its lower section and China Alley. Add the key dropped by the Warden, then build at a workbench, such as Cell Block 3rd Floor or Docks. With the shield equipped, drain three zombie souls using the key to earn a Spirit Blast. Aim and fire at the Roof voltmeter to reveal Pack-a-Punch. Later, check Roof, Power House and Building 64 when it moves. Feed the dog heads at New Industries, Cell Block 2nd Floor and Eagle Plaza. Kill one zombie at a time and wait for the chewing animation. When all three disappear, take the Warden’s House ↔ Showers fast travel and hold interact as you pass the floating Retriever. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Citadel number pad
locations.description: Read the three pillar numbers in the Warden’s Office through the shield. Spirit Blast the Citadel Tunnels number pad and enter that code. After the elevator falls, Spirit Blast the Docks voltmeter to move the crane. Throw the Retriever at the skeleton in the raised net, then collect the Spoon from the crate below. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Ritual Room chair
locations.description: Prepare a Blundergat or Magmagat for crowd control, then open the Warden’s hidden room. At the top of the Warden’s House stairs, hit the left wall with the Spoon to scratch it. Bring Brutus upstairs and throw a Monkey Bomb directly below that wall; move away and let his electrical slam break it. Enter 666 at the charged Citadel pad if you need to summon Brutus. This summon is a once-per-game resource; keep him alive until the wall is open. The Monkey Bomb route avoids waiting for his later-round electrical slam. Keep other players away from the wall so he targets the bomb. Inside the Ritual Room, pull the lever beside the electric chair and collect the red stone from the opposite table. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Laboratory quest map
locations.description: Place the red stone on the map in Richtofen’s Laboratory. Interact with the Kronorium on the floor to release the bird. Keep the shield repaired and charged: looking through it reveals clues, but Spirit Blasting spends a charge. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
